headline: Commission moved to cut a $265.80 additional rental charge at Broadmoor Apartments; other cases continued or tabled.
summary: Four rent cases were on the agenda. Two cases were continued to December 3, 2026, and a Canieso case was tabled so both sides can resolve it. Two other cases were dismissed after the tenants moved.
decisions: Continued the FRC-260723-J Vincent case to December 3, 2026.
Tabled the FRC-260821-W Canieso case to give both parties more time to resolve it.
Motion to reduce the additional rental charge by $265.80; the minutes do not record how the vote ended.
Granted the landlord's first continuance and continued the FRC-261013-D Kipperman case to December 3, 2026.
Dismissed the FRC-260906-A Warren case after the tenant moved.
Dismissed the FRC-260912-V Suscella case after the tenant was moved to a different apartment.
Approved the minutes of the October 1, 2026 meeting.

 1. FRC-260723-J Vincent V Seramonte LLC 
       
  The tenant was not present and had not provided any information to the Fair Rent 
Commission before the meeting. 
Motion: Continued to the next regular hearing on December 3, 2026.  
 2. FRC-260821-W Canieso V Seramonte LLC 
       
  Maria Canieso and Nick Walters, tenants, were sworn in by Commission Chair 
Cunningham and gave testimony. Paul Boudreau, the tenant's representative, was 
sworn in and gave testimony. Keyla Seguinot, Property Manager, was sworn in by 
Commission Chair Cunningham and gave testimony.  
Motion: Decision tabled to allow both parties additional time to resolve the matter 
independently. The commission will revisit the case at our next regular hearing on 
December 3, 2026. Motioned by Chair Peter Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner 
Robinson. 
 3. FRC-260825-E-Pazmino V Broadmoor Apartments 
       
  Joel Pazmino, tenant, was sworn in by Commission Chair Cunningham and gave 
testimony. David Miller, Property Manager, was sworn in by Commission Chair 
Cunningham and gave testimony.  
Motion: To reduce the additional rental charge by $265.80. Motioned by Chair Peter 
Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner Goldson. 
 4. FRC-261013-D-Kipperman V Atria Larson Place  
       
  Landlord requested first continuance. 
Motion: Continuance granted. The case will be continued to the next regular hearing 
on December 3, 2026. Motioned by Chair Peter Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner 
Johnson.
